title: Legends Row at Elliston Place
description:
Welcome to the Legends Row Suite, Loft 203, celebrating Nashville’s Hall of Fame inductees and timeless artists.— your all-access pass to Nashville’s legendary music scene! Just 1 mile from the neon lights of Broadway and steps from Vanderbilt, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath apartment hits all the right notes with a one-of-a-kind décor inspired by Country Western royalty. Highlights: Gold & Platinum Records line the walls — authentic memorabilia celebrating icons of country music. 3 Spacious Bedrooms ea

The space
Loft 203, Legends Row, is located right above the Elliston Place Soda Shop in the Rock Block neighborhood and within a mile of Broadway, the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, Vanderbilt University and all things downtown Nashville. Feel like a star in this immersive, music-themed space where every detail is a tribute to the legends of the Grand Ole Opry. Whether you’re headed downtown for a night out, catching a show at Ryman Auditorium, or exploring Music Row — you're just minutes away from it all.

Guest access
Rock Block Lofts have their own private entrance at the back of the Soda Shop Restaurant building. Go up a short staircase and ent through the glass doors. Loft 203 is around 2 corners to the right, at the front of the building. .
